# fw-toolcall crate

> Tool catalogue model for the aphrody agent engine: ToolDefinition (name / description / JSON-schema input & output), the async ToolExecutor trait…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-toolcall/

Tool catalogue model for the aphrody agent engine: ToolDefinition (name / description / JSON-schema input & output), the async ToolExecutor trait, ToolExposure (Direct / Deferred / DirectModelOnly / Hidden), and a JsonSchema type with prompt-budget compaction passes. Inspired by OpenAI Codex tools (Apache-2.0). Legacy crates.io name: aphrody-toolcall.
